mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application ( passport_uuid, applicant_role, company_name, country, reg_number, established_year, contact_name, contact_title, contact_email, contact_phone, buy_category, buy_volume, buy_volume_amount, buy_volume_currency, fiscal_period_start, fiscal_period_end, buy_market, sup_category, sup_capacity, sup_certs, sup_export, status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{passportUuid}, #{applicantRole}, #{companyName}, #{country}, #{regNumber}, #{establishedYear}, #{contactName}, #{contactTitle}, #{contactEmail}, #{contactPhone}, #{buyCategory}, #{buyVolume}, #{buyVolumeAmount}, #{buyVolumeCurrency}, #{fiscalPeriodStart}, #{fiscalPeriodEnd}, #{buyMarket}, #{supCategory}, #{supCapacity}, #{supCerts}, #{supExport}, #{status}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, passport_uuid, applicant_role, company_name, country, reg_number, established_year, contact_name, contact_title, contact_email, contact_phone, buy_category, buy_volume, buy_volume_amount, buy_volume_currency, fiscal_period_start, fiscal_period_end, buy_market, sup_category, sup_capacity, sup_certs, sup_export, status, review_comment, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, tenant_id, create_time, update_time FROM application WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
